title: Claude Meetings, Sheets, and Whiteboards Bring AI-Native Office Tools
summary: Anthropic launched Claude Meetings, Sheets, Whiteboards, and Interactive Connectors ahead of its IPO. Here's what each tool does and how they compare to Microsoft and Google.

Claude Office Suite


# Claude Meetings, Sheets, and Whiteboards Bring AI-Native Office Tools


By OpenTools Team


·


November 11, 2026


Anthropic launched a suite of AI‑native office tools — Claude Meetings, Sheets, Whiteboards, and Interactive Connectors — on Monday, taking direct aim at Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace. The tools share a single AI context across every surface and arrive just days before Anthropic's IPO roadshow.


## Claude Joins Your Meetings


[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) 's most aggressive move is Claude Meetings, a feature that joins[Google](https://opentools.ai/organizations/google) Meet video calls as a named, visible participant. During a call, Claude can draft plans, map out timelines on a whiteboard, answer questions in meeting chat, and pull data from connected work apps,[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/anthropic-launches-claude-meetings-to-turn-workplace-discussions-into-plans-and-tasks/) reported. After the call, notes, action items, and all materials land on claude.ai. The feature is available on Team and Enterprise plans, and works only with Google Meet at launch — no support for Zoom or[Microsoft](https://opentools.ai/organizations/microsoft) Teams yet. For privacy, Claude announces itself in the meeting chat and automatically leaves if an external guest joins, per[Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2312177/anthropic-takes-on-google-and-microsoft-with-claude-sheets/) .


## Sheets, Whiteboards, and the Shared Context Advantage


Claude Sheets is an AI-powered spreadsheet that generates multi-tab workbooks with formulas, formatting, and dropdown menus from plain-language prompts. Both people and Claude can edit cells directly, and Claude outlines every change so teams can review what was touched.[Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2312177/anthropic-takes-on-google-and-microsoft-with-claude-sheets/) confirmed the tool supports exports to Excel and CSV, plus handoffs to Airtable, Asana, and Smartsheet. Claude Whiteboards is a shared canvas where teams brainstorm with Claude in real time — including inside meetings. After a session, Claude can convert the board into a document or slide deck.[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) 's core pitch is that “Claude carries the same context through every step, so an idea can carry over from a whiteboard to a spreadsheet to a dashboard,” the company said, quoted by[Gizmodo](https://gizmodo.com/anthropic-goes-for-microsofts-crown-with-new-claude-powered-office-tools-2000837885) .


## Interactive Connectors and Claude Data


[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) also upgraded its connectors: users can now open full versions of partner apps like Adobe, Atlassian, and HubSpot directly inside Claude. Claude can make approved changes inside them — edits in Confluence and side-by-side revisions in[Box](https://opentools.ai/organizations/box) . Meanwhile, Claude Data (formerly Dashboards) connects to data warehouses including Snowflake, BigQuery, and Redshift, letting users ask plain-language questions and get dashboards that stay current, according to[Unite.AI](https://www.unite.ai/anthropic-launches-claude-whiteboards-and-sheets-in-beta/) .


## The Strategy: Office Suite as Lock-In


The office tools launch is timed to the IPO roadshow, and the strategy is clear: a chat subscription is easy to cancel, but a team's shared spreadsheets and meeting history are not. “[Microsoft](https://opentools.ai/organizations/microsoft) and[Google](https://opentools.ai/organizations/google) are bringing AI deeper into established productivity environments, while[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) is bringing more of the productivity environment into AI,” Maria Bell, senior research analyst at FDM CCS Insight, told[Computerworld](https://www.computerworld.com/article/4223177/anthropic-tries-to-make-claude-stickier-with-launch-of-docs-and-slides.html) . Microsoft shares fell about 2% on the news,[Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/technology/article/anthropic-launches-meetings-whiteboards-sheets-data-ahead-of-ipo-190548601.html) reported.


## Beta, With Limitations


Everything except Claude Data is in beta, and the tools have deliberate limitations.[Anthropic](https://opentools.ai/organizations/anthropic) product leader Nicholas Lin told[Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-10/anthropic-unveils-office-tools-ahead-of-ipo-taking-on-microsoft) that Sheets is “a relatively basic product” not built for advanced financial modeling — the integrations with existing spreadsheet tools handle those jobs better. Meetings is[Google](https://opentools.ai/organizations/google) Meet-only, restricted to Team and Enterprise plans. Sheets and Whiteboards are off by default for Enterprise plans and must be enabled by admins. Analysts uniformly agree these tools complement rather than replace[Microsoft](https://opentools.ai/organizations/microsoft) and Google: “It's unclear how many users that already have productivity suites in place will choose to move to other tools,”[Computerworld](https://www.computerworld.com/article/4223177/anthropic-tries-to-make-claude-stickier-with-launch-of-docs-and-slides.html) wrote.
